The documentation in `CHANGES.txt` ties these changes together by noting the performance improvements and the addition of tests, while the tests in `TestUtils.java` validate the correctness of the new implementations. Overall, the patch aims to improve the performance of the Solr analysis components by optimizing data structures and processing logic.
